financings_after_balance_sheet.what: Underwritten public offering of 23,014,000 common shares at $9.15 per share, closed Feb 22, 2024
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: The total estimated net proceeds to the Company from the offering are expected to be approximately $197.1 million after deducting underwriting discounts and commissions and estimated offering expenses payable by the Company.
